physical_core: unchanged ERROR: four FE0 shared stores and four CONTENT private stores
candidate_rule: On bank-winner disagreement, alpha=.5 iff .5*private_top2_gap < shared_top2_gap < private_top2_gap; otherwise alpha=1. Strict boundaries. One alpha per entire sensory decision.
rule_constants: Derived from fixed alpha=1/.5, not outcome-fitted. Binary comparison uses channels 1-0 in both sensory options; four-way uses all four channels.
learning: All three readouts share the same ERROR trajectory. ERROR signed teaching depends on private pre-outcome probabilities, not emitted action. No action-dependent environment claim.
precision_rationale: Binary historical world-effect SD=.317. n=64 yields approximate one-sided 95% sampling half-width .066 (<.07 target); planning assumption, not guarantee. Latin precision separately reported, no n extension.
adoption: One joint intersection-union decision at alpha=.05. Positive causal W-N and W raw above chance for BOTH E3 families; equal-family average causal gain vs ERROR lower bound>0; each family causal change vs ERROR lower bound>-.025; lifetime intact-old/new/revised and both E3-family taught-old/new means>=.90 and paired lower bounds>-.05; any-world >.05 taught endpoint harm probability upper bound<.10; online CPU ratio upper bound<=1.05. All required, no taskwise partial promotion.
statistics: World is unit, paired full-assay vector. One-sided t bounds for nonzero world variance, clearly stated approximation. Constant endpoints use conditional first-world atom CP bound on the remaining 63 worlds (bounded support), never a zero-width bootstrap. ERROR/Q_HALF diagnostics do not create separate adoption claims.
host_window: 8 workers max; 8h stop starting jobs, 9h record-boundary checkpoint, 9.5h shutdown ceiling; no automatic restart/resume after failure/session pause. Formal dispatcher is not released in this technical package.
resources: Qualification must forecast full run <=8h at conservative 4x measured pilot wall allowance; stored output <=4GiB and aggregate predicted RSS<=8GiB. Not a hard runtime guarantee.
stopping: A failed technical gate or mathematically degenerate candidate blocks formal launch. Failure preserves checkpoint/receipts. No threshold search, added candidate, n extension, S3/REL launch, NLP or autonomy scope. Negative science retains prior core.
limitations: This is fixed engineered read arbitration, not learned metacognition. Four visible-byte CONTENT and four output channels, prompted single byte or externally supplied paired options, teacher byte at training only. No AGI, broader context, cue-free generation, or teacher-free learning claim.
